title: Command reference + drift guard; foundational build assessed as substantially complete
summary: Added docs/orchestrator-os/COMMANDS.md listing all 45 orchestrate subcommands (generated from the CLI, model-spending ones marked) with a drift-guard test that fails if the doc and the registered set diverge; ENTRYPOINT links it. Assessment (constitution section 12 meta-economics, section 13 stop conditions): the Orchestrator OS foundation is broad and evidenced -- constitution/policy/entrypoint, protected control plane with append-only negative evidence and publication guard (mutation-tested), eval runner + capability evidence, affected-test selection, state-machine + mutation testing (found 3 real engine/test defects: FAIL-0003, FAIL-0004, the fail-open guard, plus the vacuous-invariant FND-0008), provider health, attachments, OTel trace, prior-art registry (50 projects), simplification engine, failure mining, corpus import, context-utility telemetry; 24 checkpoints, every pass gated on the full suite and pushed to main. Remaining MIE items are now gated or lower marginal value: IMP-0004 (routing by measured capability) needs real per-family sample volume no route has reached; live security evaluation is operator-gated (FND-0013, DEC-0025); holdout governance and quality/complexity budgets (MIE-0018) need operator decisions. Recommendation: move the autonomous loop to a lighter cadence or pause, and resume per-item when an operator decision or real model volume unblocks it.
